data.name: Raitik
data.long_meaning: Raitik is a Sanskrit and Hindi name for a male. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rathi', meaning chariot or vehicle, and the suffix 'ik', meaning ruler. In Hindu mythology, Raitik is the name of the sun god, Surya, who is said to ride his chariot across the sky each day.
data.spiritual_meaning: Raitik represents the power of the sun and the strength and courage it brings. It is a name for a strong and brave leader, who inspires and brings light to those around him.

data.cultural_impact: The name Raitik carries a strong cultural significance in Hinduism, as it is associated with the sun god, Surya. In Hindu mythology, Surya is revered as a powerful deity and is the source of life-giving energy. The named Raitik is believed to inherit some of these qualities, making it a prestigious and honorable name in Hindu society.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Raitik holds deep significance as it represents the divine power and energy of the sun god. It reminds us of the importance of embracing the light and warmth of the sun, both literally and metaphorically, in our lives. It also symbolizes the idea of being a 'ruler' or 'leader' in one's own life, just as the sun rules over the sky.

historical_references.reference: Raitik is mentioned in the Mahabharata, an ancient Indian epic. He was a king of the Kasi country in the Indian subcontinent during the Mahabharata period. Raitik played a significant role in the Kurukshetra War, siding with the Pandava brothers.

Another reference to Raitik can be found in the Puranas, a set of eighteen major Sanskrit texts dealing with Hindu mythology. Raitik is described as a commander-in-chief of the army of King Dasharatha, the father of Lord Rama.
